decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Appendix H Proposed Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS)SuDS Pro formaFIRE SAFETY STATEMENT dated 22.04.2026NA-R00-EX-002 Rev R00NA-R00-EX-003 Rev R00NA-R00-EX-004 Rev R00NA-R00-EX-005 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-001 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-002 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-003 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-004 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-005 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-006 Rev R00NA-R00-PR-007 Rev R00NA-R00-EX-001 Rev R00Location PlanFlood Risk Assessment (FRA) & Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) dated 20.08.2026Appendix E Environment Agency's Flood MapsAppendix C Geological MapAppendix F Greenfield Runoff RatesAppendix G Sewer Asset Map DataAppendix A Site Location MapsAppendix D Topographic MapReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.  Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.
